name: Philips Hue light (bridge, local REST API v1)

settings.label: Light number on the bridge (1, 2, ...)
settings.help:
The light's number on the Hue bridge: 1 for the first light added, then 2 and so on.
In the Hue app open Settings, Lights, and count down the list, or let OmniFlow find the lights on the bridge.

settings.label: Bridge username, stored by pairing after the link button is pressed
settings.help: The key the bridge gives OmniFlow when you press its round link button during pairing. You never type it. It stays on this phone.

settings.label: Colour gamut the light reports as capabilities.control.colorgamuttype: A, B or C (the default)
settings.help:
Which range of colours the bulb can show: A, B or C. Leave it empty for C, which newer bulbs use.
If colours look wrong on an older bulb, try A or B.

capabilities.label: White temperature in mireds (153 cool to 500 warm)
Colour, sent as xy inside the light's gamut
